storyboard.title: Dusk arrival
storyboard.description: Mellow steps onto the abandoned pathway at dusk.

storyboard.title: A first glint
storyboard.description: A faint signal glints far down the trail.

storyboard.title: Slowing down
storyboard.description: He slows, unsure, and studies the horizon.

storyboard.title: Looking around
storyboard.description: A careful look around the quiet orchard.

storyboard.title: Growing curiosity
storyboard.description: Curiosity wins; he fixes on the signal.

storyboard.title: A cautious step
storyboard.description: He edges toward the signal, wary.

storyboard.title: A closer look
storyboard.description: The framing tightens as he nears it.

storyboard.title: Reaching the spot
storyboard.description: He arrives right at the source.

storyboard.title: The unexpected
storyboard.description: Something unexpected: he recoils in surprise.

storyboard.title: Taking it in
storyboard.description: He takes it in, uneasy about what it means.

storyboard.title: Sensing danger
storyboard.description: A shadow moves; danger is sensed.

storyboard.title: The decision
storyboard.description: He steels himself and decides to run.

storyboard.title: The run
storyboard.description: A full run down the pathway.

storyboard.title: Pause and check
storyboard.description: He pauses to check his surroundings.

storyboard.title: A safe way
storyboard.description: He spots a possible safe direction.

storyboard.title: Reaching safety
storyboard.description: He walks to a safe spot at last.

storyboard.title: Catching breath
storyboard.description: He catches his breath, relieved.

storyboard.title: The meaning
storyboard.description: He investigates what the signal meant.

storyboard.title: A small smile
storyboard.description: Understanding dawns; a small smile.

storyboard.title: Closing pose
storyboard.description: An expressive, confident closing pose.
